sources.title: Fundamentals of Industrial Computed Tomography
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 工業設備預知保養
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：體素與解析度不混稱，分割依賴性可重現，缺陷判斷有獨立參考。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Keep voxel size distinct from resolution, reproduce segmentation dependence, and use an independent defect reference.
related.difference: 區分RMS、峰值及轉速條件，避免把任一特徵異常直接解讀成指定故障。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish RMS, peak and operating speed without assigning one feature uniquely to a fault.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 球孔體積V=4πr³/3，理想體素數V/a³；邊界部分體積與成像模糊使此數不等於實際分割數。 合成球孔半徑0.15 mm，立方體素邊長0.05 mm，均勻體素假設。 V=0.0141372 mm³；理想體素數=113.097，直徑跨6個體素。
RMS=√(Σxi²/N)描述能量尺度，峰值因子=max|xi|/RMS；必須固定取樣與頻帶才能比較。 純合成示例速度樣本[1,−1,2,−2] mm/s，四點只供算式教學，不足作頻譜診斷。 RMS=√(10/4)=1.58114 mm/s，峰值2 mm/s，峰值因子1.26491。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Sphere volume V=4 πr³/3 gives ideal countV/a³; partial-volume boundaries and blur make this different from actual segmentation. Synthetic spherical pore radius 0.15 mm, cubic voxel side 0.05 mm, uniform sampling. V=0.0141372 mm³; ideal count 113.097, with diameter spanning 6 voxels.

RMS=√(Σ xi²/N) measures signal scale and crest factor=max|xi|/RMS; comparisons need common sampling and bandwidth. Synthetic velocity samples[1,−1,2,−2] mm/s; four points teach arithmetic, not spectral diagnosis. RMS=1.58114 mm/s, peak 2 mm/s and crest factor 1.26491.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ABB YuMi 雙臂協作平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：體素與解析度不混稱，分割依賴性可重現，缺陷判斷有獨立參考。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Keep voxel size distinct from resolution, reproduce segmentation dependence, and use an independent defect reference.
related.difference: 找出雙臂同步瓶頸，避免把兩臂各自最快誤認為整站最快。
related.differenceEn: Identify the synchronization bottleneck rather than optimizing each arm in isolation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 球孔體積V=4πr³/3，理想體素數V/a³；邊界部分體積與成像模糊使此數不等於實際分割數。 合成球孔半徑0.15 mm，立方體素邊長0.05 mm，均勻體素假設。 V=0.0141372 mm³；理想體素數=113.097，直徑跨6個體素。
獨立備料可平行，交接必須等較慢手臂完成；T=max(TL,TR)+TH。；教學左臂 6 s、右臂 4 s、交接 2 s，兩臂未共享備料治具。；T=6+2=8 s；全串行為 6+4+2=12 s，循環縮短 33.333%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Sphere volume V=4 πr³/3 gives ideal countV/a³; partial-volume boundaries and blur make this different from actual segmentation. Synthetic spherical pore radius 0.15 mm, cubic voxel side 0.05 mm, uniform sampling. V=0.0141372 mm³; ideal count 113.097, with diameter spanning 6 voxels.

Independent preparation runs in parallel; handover waits for the slower arm: T=max(TL,TR)+TH.; Teaching times are left 6 s, right 4 s and handover 2 s, with separate preparation fixtures.; T=6+2=8 s; serial execution takes 12 s, so cycle time falls by 33.333%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
